display_name: 噪声恢复候选互补性与置信度选择诊断
description: 固定父恢复器和三个噪声自适应候选，计算源域伪目标候选并集以及输入置信度选择的修复与损伤。

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], fixed blind posterior and 3 noise-adaptive candidates; ground F candidate confidence for deployable selector and clean F pseudo target for diagnostic oracle
data.tx_sets_ref: No TX labels or U_s truth loaded in either training or evaluation

permissions.query_use: Source IQ and ground F pseudo targets for diagnostic only; no TX/U_s truth, V or test
permissions.claim_scope: Source IDs previously explored, pseudo targets only; no independent blind or real satellite claim

checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed four variants, confidence margins 0,.05,.15; oracle union uses clean F pseudo target and is non-deployable; no automatic Phase1 test.

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Source F pseudo targets not truth, source IDs previously observed in other views, no target test.

rows.method: input-only candidate F confidence selector and non-deployable clean-pseudo union oracle
rows.purpose: measure sample-level complementarity and confidence routing feasibility
rows.seed_notes: 4096 source fit IDs disjoint from 8192 existing prior IDs; fixed 384 RX8 probe
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes

notes: Oracle union uses clean F pseudo target and is not deployable or a universal bound.
Candidate confidence selector uses input-derived candidate IQ and frozen F only.
Source IDs previously explored; pseudo targets are not true labels.
No TX labels, U_s truth, V or Phase1 test IQ.
